messages:
olivia: Heads-up — planning to flip the new per-tenant quota flag in prod at 11:20 PT. Canary: 5% random tenants for 30m, then 25% for 1h if healthy. Need ops + console UX signoff and the telemetry panels to be live. @oncall FYI :rocket:

sam: quick q — what happens if a tenant hits the new quota unexpectedly? fallback policy?

olivia: fallback = soft-throttle + route to legacy quota pool; we also have ephemeral override TTL of 15m for emergency unblocks. will add to runbook.

jordan: re: telemetry — preflight script is ready, it emits trace sample ids and a header `X-Quota-Canary: true`. putting the script here: ```sh
./scripts/canary_run.sh --canary-percent 5 --duration 30m
```

anya: metrics to watch: `tenant_error_rate`, `route_miss_ratio`, `quota_bump_count`, p95/p99 latency for routing, and `quota_override_used`. can we add a small panel that shows top 10 tenants by override usage? :eyes:

mike: console UX note — add a visible banner during the canary that states "Canary active: 5% tenants" with link to the runbook and a one-click rollback that triggers the override TTL and pauses the rollout. audit log should capture operator id + snapshot id.

olivia: good call. I'll add the banner copy and wire the rollback button to call `POST /internal/configs/{id}/pause` (requires ops audit header). sample payload: ```json
{
  "operator": "<id>",
  "reason": "rollback from console",
  "snapshot": "snap-2026-03-23-1120"
}
```

sam: is the rollback action idempotent? we should avoid double-pause race conditions if two operators click.

jordan: rollback is idempotent — the API returns 200 if snapshot already paused. backend uses snapshot state CAS with etag. added a tiny backoff in the UI.

ops-bot: Deployment job queued: `canary-rollout-1779812345` scheduled at 2026-03-23T11:20:00Z. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/1779812345 :robot_face:

anya: telemetry alert thresholds I'd like: tenant_error_rate > 0.5% for 5m, route_miss_ratio delta > 2% relative to baseline, p99 latency increase > 30%. If any fire, auto-pause.

mike: confirm audit retention for this action is 90 days for compliance. ops team ok with that?

olivia: yes, 90d. final checklist from my side: preflight smoke ✅, dashboard panels live ✅, rollback button wired ✅, runbook link added ✅. setting canary now.

sam: thanks — will watch the dashboard and be on standby. gl :thumbsup:

mike: oncall will monitor, i'll stand by in #eng-oncall during the window. :lock:

olivia: launching in 5. posting follow-up when canary flips.

ops-bot: Deployment started: `canary-rollout-1779812345` at 2026-03-23T11:20:12Z.

olivia: canary flipped to 5% — samples streaming to telemetry. ping me if you see anything abnormal.

jordan: seeing expected header samples and trace ids in `canary-traces` stream. no error spikes yet.

anya: dashboard shows slight p95 blip but p99 stable. override usage 0.

sam: thumbs-up from me.

olivia: holding for 30m then bump to 25% if green. :hourglass:
